verdict.rationale: Mercury's Bill Pay, which feeds directly into Books, documents multi-layered approval rules for bills and duplicate-bill detection, which shows bills are managed and routed for approval within the platform. The capture method and payment scheduling are not evidenced, and Bill Pay is described on a separate Mercury page rather than as a Books feature. missing for 10: documented bill capture (upload/email/OCR), payment scheduling, explicit single-workflow linkage within Books, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Set up multi-layered approval rules and approve bills right inside Slack or Mercury's mobile app.
Mercury automatically detects duplicate bills, giving you an extra set of eyes and preventing you from overpaying.
All your transactions across banking, invoicing, bill pay, and more are pulled in automatically as you build your business.
